dataAvailabilityAmendment.reason: The first mechanical run showed that Yahoo supplies a 15:00 bar for only 51 instrument-days, while 14:55 is the regular final bar. Full-text review also confirmed that the paper measures the predictor through 3:00pm, skips the next half hour, and trades 3:30pm-4:00pm. The China/Yahoo mapping is therefore previous close through 14:00 as predictor, 14:00-14:25 as skip, 14:25 next-bar entry and 14:55 exit. No signal rank, threshold, universe, cost or observed return criterion was changed.
